title: Monk Rowe welcomes John LaBarbera
summary: Rowe introduces LaBarbera as trumpeter, composer and arranger; LaBarbera thanks him and mentions Pat's interview.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. I’m very pleased to have John LaBarbera with me today. I’m going to introduce you as first a fourth trumpeter, composer/arranger, and I’m very glad to have you here because I love talking about composing and arranging.
Well thanks, Monk. I’ve watched your interviews with a number of folks, including my brother Pat, and you know, I really enjoy being a part of this. Really.
